description: Ask once how a sign-in started with thalovant_begin_browser_login on this (stdio) server is going; it asks the API nothing, so polling every few seconds is fine. outcome is pending (poll again after `interval` seconds), approved (control-plane tools for this principal now use the token; tokenId, scopes and expiresAt describe it), denied (the person declined), expired (nobody approved it in time) or error (it did not complete: status, code and detail say why). method says whether it went through the browser or a device login. Every outcome but pending ends the sign-in: begin a new one to try again. The token itself is never returned.
name: thalovant_poll_browser_login
title: Poll Browser Sign-In
